notes: The prompt self-declares as a simulator and the loop is operate-a-machine-through-air, so Simulation leads. volume-open-air is the shape because open air genuinely is the play space here - the run is a freefall between skyscrapers onto discrete rooftops and landing pads, not movement across a ground plane - and the Aircraft Operation preset is built on exactly that shape, so I kept its name and its trigger-task stations bent to the jump platforms up top and the marked landing zones below, dropping social-hub and gate-progression since no shop or unlock wall was asked for. Added settlement-density for the dense modern skyscraper skyline the answers call for; the lethal ground is inherent to the shape rather than an option, so I did not add hazard-kill, whose Simulation wording is dynamic events like a collapse or rising lava. Decided without a user: towers a few hundred studs tall in one urban district, all jumps in a single map, no scoring or objective beyond surviving the landing, and the route is CHECK because falling past towers can self-occlude the play volume - if that framing cannot be verified the fallback is jumps composed over one representable surface.
